column1: # note: The worksheet at the end of the 2025 Nebraska Tax Table, for Nebraska taxable income over $77,760: (taxable income - $77,760) x .0520 plus the amount shown for the filing status, which the booklet says is the tax on $77,760.
# note: The married filing jointly or qualifying surviving spouse amount is repeated for both statuses.
# note: The booklet has all amounts entered as whole dollars, rounding 50 cents or more up.
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
